cases.name: Wanda J. Sharrah Baumgardner
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Wanda was a loving mother and sister. Wanda worked as a machine operator at Yazoo Mills in New Oxford for over 25 years. She enjoyed going on bus trips, listening to music, going out to social clubs and spending time with family and friends."
